name: nth live wallpapers
note: PORT-ONLY ED-NEW-ocean-wallpaper-1: the live wallpapers nth adds to the library, in the animated collection's format; their shaders use the animated collection's common code.

wallpapers.name: Ocean
wallpapers.desc: Deep water from below: light shafts, caustics on the sand, drifting motes, and a shark gliding across once a loop.

wallpapers.name: Gradient Plane
wallpapers.desc: A lit plane of three colours rippling in flowing noise, with grain.

wallpapers.name: Gradient Water
wallpapers.desc: A plane of colour seen low across, like water, swelling in flowing noise.

wallpapers.name: Gradient Sphere
wallpapers.desc: A lit sphere of three colours, its skin flowing.

wallpapers.name: Plasma
wallpapers.desc: Glowing plasma: domain-warped noise ramped through the colours.

wallpapers.name: Gradient
wallpapers.desc: Every shadergradient option, live: a plane, sphere or water plane in three colours, its flow, light, camera and grain all set in Appearance's Gradient section.
